summary: 30-year-old Toronto man bicycling on Trail Ridge Road about 1/4 mile east of Lava Cliffs was blown over by a thunderstorm gust exceeding 45 mph, suffering serious pelvis and head injuries despite wearing a helmet; he and his companion were also hypothermic; taken by ambulance to the Alpine Visitor Center where an air ambulance (in park on a training exercise) flew him to St. Anthony Hospital
location: Trail Ridge Road near Lava Cliffs, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers; Estes Park Medical Center ambulance; St. Anthony air ambulance
notes: Incident date pinned to Thu 2011-06-16: report filed Mon Jun 20 says the crash was "last Thursday". Weekday-verified.
